issuer: the Florida Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles (FLHSMV)
note: FLHSMV's fee schedule (read 2026-10-30) gives an original Class E licence (including the learner's licence) at $48.00 and an ID card at $25.00; a $6.25 service fee may be added at a tax collector's office, which isn't held. Its renewal page says licences and ID cards are renewed every eight years. Its teen page sets driving hours for licence holders aged 16 and 17, so a full licence is kept from 18. No youngest age for the card was read.

sources.title: FLHSMV, Fees
sources.said: Original Class E (includes Learner’s license)* $48.00 ... Identification Cards (Original, Renewal & Replacement)* $25.00

sources.title: FLHSMV, Renew or Replace Your Florida Driver License or ID Card
sources.said: Customers must renew their Florida driver license or ID card every eight years.

sources.title: FLHSMV, Licensing Requirements for Teens, Graduated Driver License Laws and Driving Curfews
sources.said: Driver License 16 years old Driving is only allowed between 6 a.m. and 11 p.m. ... Driver License 17 years old
